description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order under Section 3 of the Ports and Airports Development Levy Act. No. 18 of 2011
reasoning: This gazette notification contains an order amending the Ports and Airports Development Levy Act, No. 18 of 2011. It establishes regulatory procedures and compliance requirements for the exemption of levies on imported essential goods received as aid/donations. While it mentions Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe, the primary content focuses on legal/regulatory framework, procedures, and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) as it deals with statutory instruments and regulatory procedures under existing legislation.
